title: Normalized ordinary and derived geometric coherence
statement: Let l be prime and E a finite extension of Q_l. Let X,Y,Z satisfy the noetherian, finite-dimensional, l-invertible scheme hypotheses, with normalized continuous realizations and prescribed Along comparisons ag, ah, ac for g:X→Y, h:Z→X and h≫g, and ai for the identity of Y [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data]. There exist ordinary, cochain and ambient derived composition comparisons satisfying the coefficient, tensor-unit, component and normalized-counit equations of Composition, without its raw isomorphism or realization compatibility. There also exist the site, ordinary and ambient identity comparisons with the site-projection, tensor-unit and normalized-counit equations of Identity, without its raw isomorphism or realization compatibility. These data are the records AmbientComposition and AmbientIdentity.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), Remark 6.8.15; Stacks Tags 0D6D, 0A0E and 0A0G. Expansion of the normalized comparison argument.

proof.text: Choose the normalized rational module realizations and their pullback comparisons for g, h, h≫g and the identity. The normalized coefficient adjuncts are equal pointwise on continuous functions, hence equal by the ring-sheaf adjunction. Apply the already proved rationalScalarPullComposition and rationalScalarPullIdentity wrappers and rewrite their coefficient maps by these equalities. Retain only their ordinary comparisons, unit formulas, ambient comparisons and computation equations.

For each supplied Along, extract e and eC from IsNormalizedPullCounit. The component equation identifies eC with the degreewise image of e. The pure-section normalization, after canceling the object equality transports, says e sends the old tensor-unit section to moduleUnit. The normalized composite ringed-module and scalar adjunction gives naturality of the old unit; transport through e gives naturality of moduleUnit. Conjugate the old ordinary compositor by e_c inverse, e_h on the old g pullback, and the new h pullback of e_g. Its unit formula follows by inverse cancellation, the old unit formula and naturality along the actual fibre-product associator. For identity use e_i inverse followed by the old ordinary unitor.

Take the new complex compositor to be the degreewise image of the new ordinary compositor; its component equation is definitional. Keep the old ambient derived compositor. Expand each supplied counit as the old computation counit followed by Q(e). Cancel e_c with e_c inverse in the degreewise comparison, apply the old derived composition equation, and use naturality of the supplied h counit at the degreewise e_g. The remaining expression is the desired normalized composition equation. The identity equation follows by canceling the degreewise e_i and applying the old identity computation equation. Both equations in fact hold for every complex, so in particular under the stated K-flat and flat-term hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: T7 transport of the existing normalized rational pullback composition and identity equations through the scalar cancellation already specified by IsNormalizedPullCounit; BS Remark 6.8.15 and Stacks 0D6D.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousAmbientGeometricCoherence
    {X Y Z : Base.{u} l} (g : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme) (h : Z.scheme ⟶ X.scheme)
    (aX : At l E X) (aY : At l E Y) (aZ : At l E Z)
    (ag : Along l E g aX aY) (ah : Along l E h aZ aX)
    (ac : Along l E (h ≫ g) aZ aY) (ai : Along l E (𝟙 Y.scheme) aY aY) :
    Nonempty (AmbientComposition l E g h aX aY aZ ag ah ac) ∧
      Nonempty (AmbientIdentity l E Y aY ai)
